features: T-slotted profiles can be miter cut to angles of 0 to 75 degrees or 0 to 60 degrees for select profiles (with the exception of 3060, 40-1620 and 40-8016, which can only be cut to an angle of 45 degrees across the 6.00” (160mm) side

When ordering, designate profile end (left, right, or both) that requires miter; A drawing is required with this machining service; for project design assistance contact a Design Technician at 8020.net/design-assistance
parts.dimension_notes: A = miter angle measured from 0º (square cut); minimum and maximum angle refer to dimension A
parts.notes: Machining service listed on catalog page 11-10. Designate the profile end (left, right, or both) to be mitered; a drawing is required with this service. Per the page, 3060 can only be cut to an angle of 45 degrees across the 6.00” side.

parts.name: Miter Cut Counterbore - 1515 / 1501-1504 Profiles
parts.description: Drill-through and counterbore machining service for one end of a mitered profile (1501, 1501-LS, 1502, 1502-LS, 1503, 1503-LS, 1504, 1504-LS, 1515, 1515-S, 1515-Lite, 1515-LS, 1515-UL, 1515-ULS) to create custom supports at 30º - 60º; mounting hardware is included.
features: Includes drill through and counterbore to create custom supports with angles ranging from 30 to 60 degrees; service is for one end of profile with included mounting hardware
When ordering, designate profile end (left, right, or both) that requires miter
parts.dimension_notes: A = profile width; ø B = counterbore diameter; ø E = drill-through hole diameter; C and D locate the counterbore as shown on the drawing; *the D dimension is for profiles positioned at a 45 degree angle
parts.notes: Machining service listed on catalog page 11-12; service is for one end of the profile; the ordering example pairs it with Profile Miter Cut 7065. Included mounting hardware (15 series): 3112 bolt, 3278 Economy T-nut and 3260 washer, 1 to 6 of each. Ordering Example: (2) 1515 x 14.00” w/ #7065 @ 45º Left End Per Drawing and #7082 Left End.
